title: Microsoft Teams Rooms on Android: Event group chat for organisers and presenters in webinars and structured meetings
summary: Hold: the briefing says Microsoft has not documented an Android build for webinar and structured-meeting presenter chat, but the release notes now list it in the November 2026 build. The roadmap, rollout notice, Pro licensing and Meeting chat control otherwise check out; the Windows presenter-chat limitation needs a note about conflicting Microsoft guidance.

claims.claim: Learn's Android release notes already document Event Group chat and switching to attendee chat for town halls.
claims.quote: When a Teams Rooms on Android device is an organizer, co-organizer or presenter in a town hall, you have access to a private chat for event management known as the Event Group. You can also switch to a separate chat with attendees

claims.claim: The town hall chat entry is in Android build 1449/1.0.96.2026249711, dated September 2026.
claims.quote:
### 1449/1.0.96.2026249711 (September 2026)
Introduced in this update:
... Chat for organizers and presenters in town hall

claims.where: What's changing; Governance guidance: After rollout; Open questions
claims.claim: At the time of writing, Learn's Android release notes list only the town hall version and no build or equivalent entry for webinar and structured-meeting chat.
claims.quote:
### 1449/1.0.96.2026344105 (November 2026)
Private chat for organizers and presenters for webinars and structured meetings
claims.fix: Replace the absence sentence in What's changing with 'Microsoft Learn also lists private chat for organisers and presenters in webinars and structured meetings in Android build 1449/1.0.96.2026344105 (November 2026).' Replace the After rollout bullet with 'Check the installed Android app version against build 1449/1.0.96.2026344105 (November 2026), which the Teams Rooms release notes list as introducing this chat.' Remove the final Open questions bullet: the cited release notes now answer it.

claims.claim: Plan for Teams events says only Windows Pro rooms are officially supported as meeting and event presenters or attendees, conflicting with the roadmap and Android release notes.
claims.quote: Only Microsoft Teams Rooms on Windows with a Pro license are officially supported to join meetings and events as a presenter or as an attendee.

claims.where: Why it matters; Risk assessment: Data exposure
claims.claim: The notice says people physically in the room gain access to private presenter chat through the room.
claims.quote: When a Teams Room on Android is joined to a meeting or event as an organizer, people in the room will have access to the private chat for presenters if the meeting or event has green room enabled.

claims.claim: The front-of-room display defaults to attendee view when Android rooms join webinars or structured meetings as presenters.
claims.quote: When a Teams Rooms on Android device is invited as a presenter in a Webinar or Structured Meeting, the front-of-room display defaults to the attendee view.

claims.claim: Microsoft Support documents event group chat on the MTR console.
claims.quote: Chat privately with other event organizers, co-organizers, and presenters from an MTR console during an event in the event group chat.

claims.claim: Microsoft Support says event group chat is view-only for MTRs joined as presenters.
claims.quote: The event group chat is view-only for MTRs joined as presenters.

claims.claim: Learn lists a limitation that Windows Pro rooms can't use chat when they join meetings as presenters.
claims.quote: Microsoft Teams Rooms on Windows with a Pro license can't use chat when they join meetings as a presenter.
claims.fix: Append to this sentence: 'However, Learn's Plan for Teams meetings and Plan for Teams events tables say Windows Rooms presenters can see, but cannot send, chat messages, consistent with Support's view-only guidance.' Both planning pages are already cited: https://learn.microsoft.com/microsoftteams/plan-meetings and https://learn.microsoft.com/microsoftteams/plan-events.

claims.quote:

claims.claim: Meeting chat is configured in Teams admin center > Meetings > Meeting policies > policy > Meeting engagement > Meeting chat.
claims.quote:
In the left navigation of the Teams admin center, go to Meetings > Meeting policies.
Select the policy you want to edit.
Go to the Meeting engagement section.
Set Meeting chat to your chosen value

claims.claim: Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy -Identity <policy name> -MeetingChatEnabledType Disabled -LobbyChat Disabled is a documented MicrosoftTeams PowerShell call to disable meeting chat.
claims.quote: in order to set the value of MeetingChatEnabledType to Disabled, you will need to also set the value of LobbyChat to disabled. ... Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy -Identity Global -MeetingChatEnabledType Disabled -LobbyChat Disabled

claims.where: controls[0].note; Why it matters; Governance guidance; Governance controls; Open questions
claims.claim: Microsoft has not specifically confirmed whether the general Meeting chat policy controls this Android Event group or Planning group presenter chat.
claims.quote: Searched: "Event group" "Planning group" "Meeting chat" policy Teams Rooms Android. Read meeting-chat and event-chat guidance, planning tables, Android release notes and Support MTR guidance; no passage explicitly assigns this private Android chat to Meeting chat policy.

claims.claim: Meeting chat is a per-user policy.
claims.quote: This setting doesn't apply to channel meetings and is a per-user and per-organizer policy.

claims.claim: Meeting chat governs whether participants can read and send chat in meetings and events with up to 1,000 attendees.
claims.quote:
As an admin, you can control:
Whether participants in your users' meetings and events with up to 1,000 attendees can read and send chat messages.

claims.claim: No administrative UI or automation control for enabling green room is documented; organisers choose it for individual meetings or events.
claims.quote: Searched: Teams green room organizer meeting options enable green room PowerShell TeamsMeetingPolicy parameter; Teams green room enable API Microsoft Graph onlineMeeting virtualEventSession. Read planning tables, Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy and Graph beta meeting/session/base references: no admin control.
